title: Recorded forgetting agrees with additive evaluation
statement: Let T be a scheme, B an inverse sequence of commutative ring sheaves on its small pro-etale site, F a Forget datum, M a module system, G a tower of additive sheaves and h an isomorphism F.F(M) to G [def-sp-tower-class-systems]. For each n there is an isomorphism e from G_n to the additive sheaf of evaluation_n M. If a raw module section x is heterogeneously equal to a forgotten section x prime, then e(h(x prime)) equals x.

source.place: sec-smooth-purity, sk-prop-sp-tower-geometric, classes (2), recorded ordinary-system forgetting

proof.text: The equations F.sections identify the section groups and F.restrictions gives naturality of the equality transports. They give a presheaf isomorphism and hence a sheaf isomorphism from the forgotten level to the additive module evaluation. Compose it with the inverse of h at n. On a section h(x prime), the inverse cancels h; equality transport then sends x prime to its heterogeneously equal raw representative x.

theorem forget_evaluation_iso (T : Scheme.{u})
    (B : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (F : Forget T B) (M : Systems T B) (n : ℕ)
    (G : Ab T) (h : F.F.obj M ≅ G) :
    ∃ e : G.obj (op n) ≅
      (SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).obj
        ((SemilinearSections.evaluation.{u + 1, u, u + 1} (Scheme.ProEt.topology T)
          (fun n ↦ B.obj (op n))
          (fun n ↦ B.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op) n).obj M),
      ∀ (U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : M.val.obj (op (n, U.unop)))
        (x' : ((F.F.obj M).obj (op n)).obj.obj U),
        HEq x x' → e.hom.hom.app U (((h.hom.app (op n)).hom.app U) x') = x
